reading: Every measurement taken while the pack was written, in order and verbatim, the bad ones included. All numbers measure internal consistency on synthetic data (generator, gold and rules share an author); none measures accuracy on real companies. Blind runs are appended by whoever runs them (see eval/BLIND_PROTOCOL.md).

runs.note: First run ever of the pipeline against a gold. Read with care: the same author wrote templates, gold and rules, so a clean dev result mostly shows that the three agree with each other.

results.label: dev
results.role: development: inspected while the rules were written

runs.note: Holdout: scored, not inspected. Stress (perturbed wording): first run, 32 never-events. Two causes found by reading the stress cases: (a) a document whose type wording was not recognised was left out, and an older value or a one-sided value was shown as fact; (b) when one current source could not be read, the value of the other current source was shown as fact although the unread one might disagree.
